(4) Effectiveness of LVW in Outlier Optimization. We observed that the pixel error histograms follow a Laplace-like distribution, suggesting the model optimizes accurate pixels while neglecting outliers [27]. Based on L1 Loss, LVW adjusts weights to increase the constraint on outliers. Normalization standardizes errors, bringing the data distribution closer to uniform and ensuring balanced pixel weights. Additionally, we visualized the pixel prediction error histograms for different loss functions, as shown in Figure 14. Conclusion In this paper, we introduce MobileIE, a lightweight CNN with only 4K parameters designed for real-time image enhancement on mobile devices. MobileIE combines simplicity with high performance across low-light image enhancement, underwater image enhancement, and image signal processing tasks. Key components such as the MBRConv, Feature Self-Transform module, Hierarchical Dual-Path Attention mechanism, and Local Variance-Weighted loss enable MobileIE to achieve superior results while maintaining an inference time of around 0.9 ms. Furthermore, MobileIE can be easily deployed on any commercial mobile device with minimal computational overhead and efficient resource utilization. Future work will explore optimizations to expand MobileIE’s application to more different tasks. 21956-------------------------------------------------------------------------------- MobileIE/README.md at main · AVC2-UESTC/MobileIE · GitHub (https://github.com/AVC2-UESTC/MobileIE/blob/main/README.md) citeturn20search0 [wordlim: 200] Crawled: last week; # [ICCV 2025] MobileIE: An Extremely Lightweight and Effective ConvNet for Real-Time Image Enhancement on Mobile Devices # [ICCV 2025] MobileIE: An Extremely Lightweight and Effective ConvNet for Real-Time Image Enhancement on Mobile Devices * * * Hailong Yan^{1}  Ao Li^{1}  Xiangtao Zhang^{1}  Zhe Liu^{1}  Zenglin Shi^{2}  Ce Zhu^{1}  Le Zhang^{1,†}  ^{1} UESTC   ^{2} Hefei University of Technology ^{†} Corresponding author. #### 📄 arXiv Paper   > Abstract: Recent advancements in deep neural networks have driven significant progress in image enhancement (IE). However, deploying deep learning models on resource-constrained platforms, such as mobile devices, remains challenging due to high computation and memory demands. To address these challenges and facilitate real-time IE on mobile, we introduce an extremely lightweight Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) framework with around 4K parameters. Our approach integrates reparameterization with an Incremental Weight Optimization strategy to ensure efficiency. Additionally, we enhance performance with a Feature Self-Transform module and a Hierarchical Dual-Path Attention mechanism, optimized with a Local Variance-Weighted loss. With this efficient framework, we are the first to achieve real-time IE inference at up to 1,100 frames per second (FPS) while delivering competitive image quality, achieving the best trade-off between speed and performance across multiple IE tasks. ### Preparation 1. Replace the dataset path in the config file. 2. If you want to train the model, set the type in config to "original" and need_slims to "false". 3. If you want to test the pretrain model, set the type in config to "re-parameterized", need_slims to "true", and load the re-parameterized pre-trained model. You can also run inference with TFLite model by executing "test_TFLite_RGB.py/test_TFLite_ISP.py". 4. You can use the TFLite model and import it into AI Benchmark (https://ai-benchmark.com/) to obtain the inference speed on mobile devices. 5. If you want to perform UIE task, replace the dataset path in config/lle.yaml with your underwater image dataset. ### Train python main.py -task train -model_task lle/isp -device cuda ### Test python main.py -task test -model_task lle/isp -device cuda ### Demo python main.py -task demo -model_task lle/isp -device cuda ### Contact If you have any questions, please contact me by e-mail (yanhailong@std.uestc.edu.cn; yhl00825@163.com). ### Citation If you find the code helpful in your research or work, please cite the following paper: `@InProceedings{yan2025mobileie, author = {Yan, Hailong and Li, Ao and Zhang, Xiangtao and Liu, Zhe and Shi, Zenglin and Zhu, Ce and Zhang, Le}, title = {MobileIE: An Extremely Lightweight and Effective ConvNet for Real-Time Image Enhancement on Mobile Devices}, booktitle = {Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision}, month = {October}, year = {2025}, } `-------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 李骜-重庆师范大学计算机与信息科学学院 (https://jxxy.cqnu.edu.cn/info/2161/8482.htm) citeturn20search1 [wordlim: 200] Published: 2 months ago; Crawled: last month; Deep-Learning-Empowered Super-Resolution: A Comprehensive Survey and Future Prospects[J]. ... MobileIE直接借鉴并发展了在训练期间使用多分支拓扑的思想，该拓扑可以在推理时融合成一个简单、快速的架构，因此，理解MobileIE的设计，此引文至关重要。 提交于 2025年7月2日 # MobileIE: 面向移动设备的超轻量高效实时图像增强卷积网络 UESTC Hefei University of TechnologyHailong Yan AL Ao Li XZ Xiangtao Zhang ZL Zhe LiuZenglin ShiCe ZhuLe Zhang ## 摘要 深度神经网络的近期突破极大地推动了图像增强 (IE) 领域的发展。然而，由于其高计算和内存开销，在移动设备等资源受限平台上部署深度学习模型仍然充满挑战。为了解决这些挑战并促进移动设备上的实时IE，我们引入了一个参数量约为4K的极其轻量级的卷积神经网络 (CNN) 框架。我们的方法将重参数化与增量权重优化策略相结合，以确保高效率。此外，我们通过特征自变换模块和分层双路径注意力机制增强了性能，并通过局部方差加权损失对其进行了优化。凭借这一高效框架，我们首次实现了高达每秒1,100帧 (FPS) 的实时IE推理，同时提供了具有竞争力的图像质量，并在多项IE任务中实现了速度与性能之间的最佳权衡。## 实验结果 MobileIE 在三项具有挑战性的图像增强任务中表现出色：低光增强 (LLE)、水下图像增强 (UIE) 和图像信号处理 (ISP)。 ### 模型效率 该模型实现了卓越的紧凑性，仅有 **~4K 参数（0.02 MB）**和 0.924 GFLOPs 的计算成本。推理速度在 GPU 上达到 1,120 FPS，在 移动 SoC（骁龙 8 Gen 3）上高达 1,100 FPS，对应的推理延迟约为 0.9-14.4 毫秒，具体取决于任务。 ### 增强质量 尽管设计极其轻量化，MobileIE 仍提供了具有竞争力或更优的图像质量指标： * 低光增强：在 LOLv1 上达到 23.62 PSNR，0.812 SSIM；在 LOLv2-Real 上达到 25.08 PSNR，0.845 SSIM * 水下增强：在 UIEB 数据集上达到 22.81 PSNR，0.906 SSIM * ISP：在 ZRR 数据集上达到 21.43 PSNR，0.731 SSIM 该模型在所有任务中始终获得最高的“分数”（综合性能-效率指标），超越了明显更大、更慢的替代方案。 ### 比较分析 MobileIE 仅用 IAT 4.7% 的参数，速度却比其 快 6.9 倍，超越了轻量级 SOTA 方法 IAT。与 FiveA+ 等其他高效模型相比，它在仅使用 45% 参数的情况下实现了更优的 PSNR。 ## 消融研究与分析 全面的消融研究验证了每个组件的贡献： * MBRConv 有效性：相对于 RepVGG 基线提供了 +3.08 dB PSNR 改进 * IWO 策略：防止训练停滞并减少通道冗余，通过通道分布之间增加的 KL 散度得到证明 * FST 模块：加速收敛并提高最终性能（在 UIEB 上 +1.48 dB PSNR） * HDPA 注意力：以极小的开销（+0.168K 参数）实现了显著增益（+3.08 dB） * LVW 损失：与标准 L1/L2 损失相比，减少了平均和中位数像素误差 Image: Loss Comparison 图：不同损失函数的比较，显示 LVW 损失（青色）与 L1、L2 和 Smooth L1 损失相比，如何更好地处理异常值。 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- dblp: MobileIE: An Extremely Lightweight and Effective ConvNet for Real-Time Image Enhancement on Mobile Devices.
